description: Read the payout account of the caller's organization, as the web app's payout account page shows it: its state (disabled, handle_blocked, not_started, country_blocked, setup_incomplete, restricted, or enabled), the facts behind that state, requestedAt (when request_payout_account_setup asked, or null), and by state the setup steps with whether each is done, the hold with its open items or the end of a bank change pause, the country on file, or the bank account's last four digits. Needs a credential.
name: get_payout_account
title: Get payout account
